name: 小包装库存与整托排序
Compact stock and unit loading order
rows.proof: At most 23 cartons per unit by 1000 / 42 kg. Small-base stock is 13; 14 floor units require at least one large base and occupy at least 13*1800*1100+2743*2233 mm², exceeding the net floor. A validated 13-small-unit witness attains 299 cartons. No stacked units or loose cargo.

name: 两组余货与共享地板空隙
Joint tails in a shared floor strip
rows.proof: The original order contains 12 A + 12 B = 24 cartons, an absolute demand bound. Two SKU-specific pallets each hold 8 cartons; the shared 400 mm floor strip holds the remaining 4 A + 4 B. A validated witness reaches all 24 without adding packaging stock or cross-supporting pallets and loose cargo.

name: 三组尾数与逐行守恒
Three tail groups and row conservation
rows.proof: Original demand is 10 A + 10 B + 10 C = 30 cartons. Three registered SKU-specific pallets each carry eight, while the shared 400 mm floor strip carries the remaining two from each row. A validated 30-carton witness reaches the demand bound without extra packaging stock or cross-support.
